author: Binay Verma
status: Registered before any p-value or interval was computed. The cluster values themselves were already reported descriptively (signs, ranges), so this is a pre-specified secondary analysis, not a confirmation.
question: Are the typed-minus-pooled event MASE differences distinguishable from zero, and from year to year, once clusters are the unit?

tests.T1: India: exact sign-flip on 10 family-year cluster differences per model/representation/lead (36 cells).
tests.T2: India: exact sign-flip on 5 family-level (2025 - 2024) differences per cell (year interaction).
tests.T3: NYC: exact sign-flip on 4 family-mode cell differences per model/representation/decision lead (36 cells).

statistic: mean of cluster values; two-sided; ties counted with tolerance 1e-12
multiplicity: Holm across the 36 cells within each of T1, T2, T3; alpha 0.05
secondary: 95% cluster-mean t interval (df = clusters - 1), descriptive only
interpretation: A cell is called "detected" only if its Holm-adjusted p < 0.05. Otherwise "not detected", which is not evidence of no difference. Minimum attainable two-sided p: T1 2/1024, T2 2/32, T3 2/16 (T2 and T3 cannot reach 0.05 after Holm; this is reported as a power limit).
assumptions: Clusters exchangeable in sign under H0. Family-year clusters in the same year share conditions and the NYC modes are related, so the tests are approximate; no p-value here is a confirmation.
